dialogues.speaker: Arina
dialogues.text: I want a break... Why can't the Akademiya give us some time off during the Extravaganza?

dialogues.speaker: Armin
dialogues.text: Don't you enjoy watching the competition?

dialogues.speaker: Arina
dialogues.text: No, I do but... If you think about it, we can only watch the competitions if we have a break, right?

dialogues.speaker: Armin
dialogues.text: Yeah, that makes sense... Though, watching all my senior classmates represent their Darshans has inadvertently inspired a new drive in me to study!

dialogues.speaker: Armin
dialogues.text: I've made up my mind. In the future, I'm going to enter the Interdarshan Championship too!

dialogues.speaker: Arina
dialogues.text: Huh... It's a bit early to be thinking about this, isn't it? Didn't our instructors say that seeking knowledge should be a steady and serious endeavor?

dialogues.speaker: Arina
dialogues.text: Maybe before considering partaking in a competition that happens once in a blue moon, maybe you should consider which Darshan you want to join first?
